vikisozluk.baslik:
صهين (form I)
# صَهَيْنَ (ṣahayna) /sˤa.haj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of صَهَى (ṣahā)
# صَهِينَ (ṣahīna) /sˤa.hiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of صَهِيَ (ṣahiya)

صهينا (form I)
# صَهَيْنَا (ṣahaynā) /sˤa.haj.naː/: first-person plural past active of صَهَى (ṣahā)
# صَهِينَا (ṣahīnā) /sˤa.hiː.naː/: first-person plural past active of صَهِيَ (ṣahiya)

صهيت (form I)
# صَهَيْتُ (ṣahaytu) /sˤa.haj.tu/: first-person singular past active of صَهَى (ṣahā)
# صَهَيْتَ (ṣahayta) /sˤa.haj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of صَهَى (ṣahā)
# صَهَيْتِ (ṣahayti) /sˤa.haj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of صَهَى (ṣahā)
# صَهِيتُ (ṣahītu) /sˤa.hiː.tu/: first-person singular past active of صَهِيَ (ṣahiya)
# صَهِيتَ (ṣahīta) /sˤa.

صهيتما (form I)
# صَهَيْتُمَا (ṣahaytumā) /sˤa.haj.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of صَهَى (ṣahā)
# صَهِيتُمَا (ṣahītumā) /sˤa.hiː.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of صَهِيَ (ṣahiya)

صهيا (form I)
# صَهَيَا (ṣahayā) /sˤa.ha.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of صَهَى (ṣahā)
# صَهِيَا (ṣahiyā) /sˤa.hi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of صَهِيَ (ṣahiya)

صهيتم (form I)
# صَهَيْتُمْ (ṣahaytum) /sˤa.haj.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of صَهَى (ṣahā)
# صَهِيتُمْ (ṣahītum) /sˤa.hiː.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of صَهِيَ (ṣahiya)

صهيتن (form I)
# صَهَيْتُنَّ (ṣahaytunna) /sˤa.haj.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of صَهَى (ṣahā)
# صَهِيتُنَّ (ṣahītunna) /sˤa.hiː.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of صَهِيَ (ṣahiya)
